accessories.value: "Please attach two (2) passport pictures" — two photos required with the Entry Visa Application form; no size/background/pose specification printed on the form itself (just an 'Affix Photo' box)

accessories.en: Two (2) passport-style photographs must be attached to the Entry Visa Application form.
accessories.ko: 입국비자 신청서에 여권용 사진 2매를 첨부해야 함.
accessories.ja: 入国ビザ申請書にパスポート用写真2枚を添付する必要がある。

cross_verification.note_en: Confirmed via the official Ministry of National Security, Air and Sea Port Development (security.gov.vc) 'Entry Visa Application Form' PDF, issued to nationals of a short list of countries requiring a Saint Vincent and the Grenadines entry visa (fee EC$200, non-refundable). Unlike the passport Form A, this visa form does not print any photo size/background/pose rule — only the requirement of two photos and an 'Affix Photo' box. Left size/background/etc. unverified rather than assuming they mirror the passport rule (vc-passport), since that would not be a directly confirmed fact for this specific document.
